definitions.gloss: shellfish gathering; clamming; digging for clams at low tide
definitions.explanation: A popular recreational activity in Japan, typically done in spring, where people gather clams and other shellfish on tidal flats during low tide.

examples.english: We go clamming when spring comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{潮干狩|しおひが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed shellfish gathering as a family.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{潮干狩|しおひが}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{干潟|ひがた}→干潟：05592_higata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Golden Week is clamming season, and many people visit the tidal flats.

notes: A seasonal spring activity popular with families, especially during Golden Week (late April to early May). The main target is ⟦あさり→アサリ：10207_asari⟧ (short-necked clam). Famous spots include {千葉|ちば}⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ and {愛知|あいち}⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ coastal areas. The word combines {潮干|しおひ} (ebb tide) with ⟦{狩|か}り→狩り：02689_kari⟧ (hunting/gathering). Related: ⟦{干潟|ひがた}→干潟：05592_higata⟧ (tidal flat), ⟦{大潮|おおしお}→大潮：27211_ooshio⟧ (spring tide — the best time for clamming).
